dashboard.label: SOC Incidents Overview
dashboard.description: Phase 2 attack detection overview — recon, brute force, PowerShell

search.query: index=* sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=4625 | stats count by Source_Network_Address, Account_Name | sort -count

index=* sourcetype=WinEventLog:Security EventCode=5156 | bucket _time span=60s | stats dc(Destination_Port) as ports_scanned, values(Destination_Port) as ports by _time, Source_Address | where ports_scanned > 3 AND Source_Address != "10.0.2.15" AND Source_Address != "127.0.0.1" AND Source_Address != "192.168.56.101" AND Source_Address != "-" AND NOT match(Source_Address, "^::") AND NOT match(Source_Address, "^fe80") | sort -ports_scanned

index=* EventCode=4104 ("DownloadString" OR "IEX" OR "whoami" OR "EncodedCommand") | rex field=Message "(?s)text \(\d+ of \d+\):\s*(?<Script_Payload>.*?)\s*ScriptBlock ID" | table _time, host, Script_Payload | sort -_time

index=* (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4688 OR EventCode=4104 OR EventCode=5156) | eval Attack_Type=case( EventCode=4625, "Brute Force", EventCode=5156, "Network Recon", EventCode=4104, "PowerShell Execution", EventCode=4688, "Process Creation") | table _time, host, Attack_Type, EventCode | sort -_time | head 50
